title: Security Misconfiguration
description: Alfheim demonstrates security misconfiguration through exposed cloud metadata services (IMDS) accessible via SSRF bypass techniques.
theme: Norse realm of light elves - where clouds and light (cloud metadata) can be reached

vulnerabilities.type: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) with Cloud Metadata Access

endpoints.description: URL proxy with insufficient SSRF protections
Simulated AWS IMDS endpoint (should not be publicly accessible)
IMDSv2 token generation (misconfigured to be accessible)

vulnerabilities.description: The proxy service has weak SSRF protections that can be bypassed using URL encoding, redirect chains, or DNS rebinding. This allows access to the internal metadata service (simulated AWS IMDS) which contains sensitive credentials and configuration.
vulnerabilities.impact: Access to cloud metadata, credential theft (IAM roles, API keys), lateral movement, privilege escalation, data exfiltration
exploit_steps: Test basic SSRF with internal URLs
Identify SSRF filter bypasses (URL encoding, redirects, DNS tricks)
For IMDSv2: First obtain session token from /api/imds/token
Enumerate IMDS paths to find credentials
Extract IAM role credentials or flags from metadata
Use credentials to access additional resources
exploit_indicators: Access to /api/imds/ endpoints from external sources
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict SSRF protections: allowlist approach for URLs, validate URL schemes, block private IP ranges, use network segmentation. For cloud environments: enforce IMDSv2 with hop limit = 1, require authentication tokens, apply IAM role restrictions, use VPC endpoints.

endpoints.description: IMDS endpoints accessible without proper access controls

vulnerabilities.description: The cloud metadata service (IMDS) is misconfigured to be accessible from the application layer without proper authentication or network restrictions.
vulnerabilities.impact: Credential exposure, configuration leakage, lateral movement capabilities
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce IMDSv2 with hop limit restrictions. Implement network-level access controls. Use security groups to restrict metadata access. Apply authentication requirements for all IMDS access.

flags.retrieval_method: Bypass SSRF protections to access IMDS, extract flag from metadata endpoint

scanner_test_cases.name: Test SSRF filter bypass with encoding

expected_response.notes: May bypass filters with URL encoding or other techniques
Should require authentication but may be exposed
